mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_question_answer (question_id, user_id, content, like_count, comment_count, is_accepted, audit_status, is_deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{questionId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{likeCount}, #{commentCount}, #{isAccepted}, #{auditStatus}, #{isDeleted}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
INSERT IGNORE INTO tb_answer_like (answer_id, user_id, create_time) VALUES (#{answerId}, #{userId}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_question_answer SET audit_status = #{auditStatus}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE answer_id = #{answerId} AND audit_status = 0 AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE tb_question_answer SET audit_status = #{newAuditStatus}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE answer_id = #{answerId} AND audit_status = #{oldAuditStatus} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_question_answer WHERE question_id = #{questionId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND audit_status = 1 ORDER BY is_accepted DESC, like_count DESC, create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM tb_question_answer WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY answer_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
